subject: Request: temporary sandbox top-up for geo-distributed latency soak
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@quickcart.io>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuickCart POC — short window for geo latency soak

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the runtime behavior. We want to run a focused latency soak across our EU and US regions over a 36-hour window next week to validate p95 and cold-start tail behavior before committing to a Dedicated capacity pilot.

Ask: Can Redwood provision a temporary sandbox credit top-up for the POC? Rough numbers: ~60k generated-token-equivalents (expected cost ~USD 1,800) plus elevated concurrency for a 36-hour soak (we'll push 200–400 qps in short bursts). Target start: Tue Apr 17 00:00 UTC; end Wed Apr 18 12:00 UTC.

We can share a brief MAP and timeline — procurement wants a short note they can attach to the purchase request. Also happy to accept a short promo/credit voucher instead of a formal invoice.

Cc’ing our procurement alias (procure@quickcart.io) to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Product
QuickCart

Attachment: POC_plan_summary.xlsx (referenced)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@quickcart.io>, procure@quickcart.io
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickCart POC — short window for geo latency soak

Hi Elena — great to hear the demo landed well.

We can support the 36-hour soak and escalate the request to engineering for a short preflight (routing and cache warm-up recommendations). A few quick clarifying items before Ben and Vivek sign off on a credit grant: 

- Finalized traffic profile: can you confirm expected average qps and peak burst length?
- Confirmed start/end in UTC so we align scheduling with infra ops.
- Any specific SLA/fallback requirements for the test (e.g., hard p99 threshold or acceptable error budget)?

We can offer a promotional sandbox top-up (covering the ~60k token estimate) plus priority routing for the soak window, provided we receive a 1-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a technical contact on call. I've cc’d Ben for approval of the promo allocation and Vivek for the preflight checklist and kernel selection.

If that all looks good I’ll prepare the MAP template and the DocuSign voucher link.

Thanks — Camila
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx (template)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, Elena Torres <elena.torres@quickcart.io>, procure@quickcart.io
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickCart POC — short window for geo latency soak

Camila / Elena — approved.

We will authorize a one-time promotional credit covering up to USD 2,000 for the soak, subject to these conditions:
1) QuickCart returns a signed MAP (one page) by EOD Mon Apr 15.
2) Technical contact is reachable during the test window (phone + Slack).
3) Redwood is credited for any joint benchmarking content created from the test (we’ll agree to a public summary if both sides approve).

I’ll generate the HubSpot promo code and the DocuSign voucher; Camila, please send the voucher link back to Elena and cc procurement.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: procure@quickcart.io
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@quickcart.io>
Date: 2028-04-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickCart POC — short window for geo latency soak

Hi Ben / Camila,

Thanks — procurement here. Two quick items to close our internal ticket: 1) We need a short SOC2 or security snapshot to attach to our request (redwood SOC2 summary or attestation). 2) If you’re issuing a promo voucher instead of an invoice, please confirm the voucher ID and the monetary equivalent.

Also please confirm whether the sandbox traffic will cross EU regions — we need to record data residency notes in our request.

Best,
Qi Zhao
Director, Procurement
QuickCart
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: procure@quickcart.io, Elena Torres <elena.torres@quickcart.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-13T17:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickCart POC — short window for geo latency soak

Qi / Elena —

Attached is a short SOC2 summary and the one-page MAP filled in with the test dates and contact info. Promo voucher details below: 

- Voucher ID: RW-PROMO-QC-0428-1
- Monetary equivalent: USD 2,000 (applies to sandbox credits; expires 2028-05-31)

Quick notes on residency: traffic will be routed to EU nodes for EU-based clients during the soak; no customer data will be persisted outside configured regions and logs are retained per your MAP entry (30 days) unless you request otherwise.

DocuSign link to accept MAP/voucher: https://www.docusign.com/quickcart-rw-map-0428
HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/87654321-QC-2028-07

Vivek — please flag any infra preflight items you want me to add to the MAP (kernel selection, suggested batching window, KV warmup cadence).

Thanks — Camila
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (application/pdf); mutual_action_plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
